tools.name: structure.align_structures
tools.title: Align Molecular Structures
tools.description: Independently align a mobile loaded structure object onto a reference selection using protein C-alpha TM-align, sequence-guided superposition, or paired atoms. Protein TM-align uses one C-alpha coordinate per residue; use sequence or atoms for nucleic acids, coarse structures, or other polymers. Applies the transformation to the live viewer and returns RMSD, aligned count, scores, the reproducible matrix, and explicit Mol* implementation/version and correspondence provenance. Both targets must include objectId.

tools.name: structure.analyze
tools.title: Analyze Molecular Structure
tools.description: Run bounded contacts, clashes, valence- and geometry-screened hydrogen bonds, RMSD, centroid, principal-axis, best-fit-plane, SASA, buried-area, or map-correlation analysis. Hydrogen-bond donor/acceptor roles are independent of selection order; endpoints and chosen hydrogen/heavy-atom geometry participants require positive occupancy and compatible alternate locations; and every row reports explicit-H, inferred-H, or protonation-ambiguous confidence plus its assumption and the chosen explicit donor-H identity, alternate location, and occupancy. RMSD requires at least three non-collinear pairs: two atom_ids selections are paired in their requested order; other selections use stable biochemical identity matching and report unmatched or ambiguous atoms. Otherwise unique cross-object candidates must have the same alternate-location label; different isolated conformers are unmatched. Repeated model, symmetry, or alternate-conformer copies are ambiguous because their labels are source-local; use explicit ordered atom IDs to establish intentional correspondence. Buried-area partners must be atom-disjoint; overlap is rejected with atom-count, coverage, and example-ID diagnostics. Spatially indexed SASA publishes live progress, yields during planning and execution for cancellation/deadlines, and rejects work above the advertised atom, sample, neighbor-candidate, and occlusion-check budgets. Residue SASA accepts the entire occluder context plus an optional scoped output subset, absolute/relative exposure thresholds, and authoritative Tien 2013 residue maxima. Returns typed paginated rows with units, provenance, truncation, cursors, and a live result inventory.

tools.name: structure.control_viewer
tools.title: Control Molecular Structure Viewer
tools.description: Control or query the active Molecular Structure Viewer. Always pass sessionId and action, never viewerSessionId or command. Exact actions: cancel_analysis, clear_selection, focus_ligand, focus_residue, measure_residue_distance, reset_view, select_chain, select_residue_range, select_residues, set_color, set_display_mode, set_representation, set_toolbar_visibility, set_view_options, set_workspace_options, and show_ligand_contacts. set_toolbar_visibility requires visible:true or visible:false and controls the viewport tool rail; Controls remains available to reopen the inspector. set_view_options.showMoleculeInspector is a compatibility alias for the RCSB Measurements section, not a separate inspector. set_workspace_options accepts the shared visibility/picking fields and bounded sequenceView filters; use exact current object, author/label chain, entity, model, and instance identities, or the same-object showKnownSequence shortcut. cancel_analysis cooperatively stops the active structure.analyze call without waiting behind it. set_representation uses the compact primary-display values cartoon, surface, sphere, ballStick, or stick; small molecules accept only ballStick or stick, and unsupported combinations fail without changing the viewer. focus_residue and residue/chain selection actions accept optional objectId to target any loaded structure. Biological-assembly copies retain distinct instanceId values in live context; pass instanceId (and instanceIdB for the second distance endpoint) to target one copy. Ambiguous single-residue or ligand requests return valid instance candidates instead of choosing silently. Use reset_view to fit the camera. Call this tool directly from the conversation that contains the mounted viewer; do not delegate live-viewer control to a subagent and do not use browser or DevTools automation. Residue numbers use author numbering; supply insertion codes when present.

action.description: Exact viewer action. Use cancel_analysis to stop active analysis work out of band; use reset_view to fit the structure camera.

tools.name: structure.export
tools.title: Export Molecular Scene Data
tools.description: Export an atomic workspace artifact with revision and provenance checks. Formats: scene-json; selection-pdb, selection-mmcif or selection-bcif for current/requested coordinates; models-mmcif or models-bcif for split-model ZIP archives with source categories and identity manifests; geometry-glb, geometry-stl, geometry-obj (OBJ+MTL ZIP), or geometry-usdz for currently visible rendered geometry; results-csv for analysis/measurements. Geometry exports reject selection parameters and unsupported visible geometry rather than silently omit it: hide unwanted representations first. STL has no colors; other geometry formats preserve colors and transforms, with the export coordinate transform recorded. Models default to all loaded atoms; selections default to the current selection. Use mmCIF/BinaryCIF for identifiers or multiple model/instance identities that PDB cannot preserve; PDB is limited to 99,999 atoms and author residue numbers -999 through 9,999. Coordinate-only exports omit explicit bonds and report remapping. All exports are bounded to 16 MiB; results CSV is formula-neutralized with reversible spreadsheetSafety provenance.

tools.name: structure.open_from_chat
tools.title: Open Molecular Structure Viewer from chat
tools.description: Open a supported molecular structure in an inline Mol* viewer. Pass exactly one source: the exact local path, or exampleId=gfp-1ema when the user asks to view an example, generic, or demo protein structure without naming a source. The bundled example is offline and read-only. Generate one openIntentId UUID for this user request and reuse it for every delivery retry. Omit reopen for an initial open or retry; only when the user explicitly asks for another viewer, generate a new UUID and set reopen=true. For comparisons, open once and call structure.add_structure rather than opening another viewer. The result structuredContent includes viewerSessionId; for same-turn follow-up actions, pass that ID directly to structure.control_viewer without waiting for later model context. sessionReady confirms the server session only; viewerReady is true only after the authenticated viewer has actually rendered the structure. viewerOpen.renderState is pending, ready, or error. Never describe presentation-issued, mount-pending, a pending render, or a failed render as an already visible viewer. For an ordinary open, call this installed tool directly; do not launch localhost servers, browser or DevTools automation, edit files, or construct a test harness. Ask the user to click or expand the embedded Structure open from chat tool card; once it appears, they can use Open in side pane or ask you to control that same viewer. Do not repeat or format the file name or path in the user-facing response; it is not the opening action.

tools.name: structure.quality_assessment

tools.description: Load genuine embedded model quality or the wwPDB validation report for an explicit public PDB accession. Query returns bounded retained metrics, exact residue indices, and an embedded PAE selection fingerprint; residueRegion queries expose both heatmap axes and only genuine sparse cells. Select applies the union of exact retained indices or a bounded PAE rectangle through the canonical revision-guarded 3D selection. Only load can contact a public provider. Query returns both axis identities and genuine sparse cells; select uses the union of its row and column residues. Use either residueRegion or residueIndices for selection.

selectionFingerprint.description: For select only: the source/data fingerprint returned by querying the chosen embedded PAE metric.

residueIndices.description: For select only: exact retained residue indices from the embedded PAE data, not author residue numbers. Both heatmap axes select their union in all matching assembly copies.

Query returns both axis identities and genuine sparse cells; select uses the union of its row and column residues. Use either residueRegion or residueIndices for selection.

tools.name: structure.render_image
tools.title: Render Molecular Structure Image
tools.description: Render a reproducible PNG (default), JPEG, or WebP from the active Molecular Structure Viewer. The declarative scene can set camera vectors and field of view, clipping, background, lighting, antialiasing, named-object representation layers, scientific or exact colors, molecular labels, measurements, fixed screen text, and selection-anchored annotations. Optional autoCrop measures the final annotated RGBA image and records exact crop and output dimensions. JPEG is opaque; PNG and host-supported WebP may be transparent. JPEG/WebP quality is bounded from 0 to 1. Targets may address explicit structures or the primary current selection or focus. The viewer saves the encoded image plus a replay and provenance sidecar in the active workspace; do not emit a PyMOL script. Set waitForCompletion=false only when you intend to poll structure.get_render_status.

autoCrop.description: Crop uniform background around the rendered scene, including annotations. Defaults to false; output provenance records the exact pixel crop.

cropPadding.description: Padding in source pixels around an automatic crop, clamped to the requested image. Defaults to 16.

relativePath.description: Create-new destination relative to the trusted opened source. Parent segments are accepted only when the server proves containment in the same active workspace root.

format.description: Image encoding. Defaults to png. JPEG is opaque; WebP requires an encoder supplied by the mounted host.

quality.description: JPEG or WebP encoding quality, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.9. Not applicable to lossless PNG.

clippingRadius.description: Absolute clipping radius in angstroms, retained by canonical camera snapshots.

zoom.description: Magnification relative to the focused view; 2 means twice as close.

density.description: Complete density-channel appearances with exact loaded source/channel SHA-256 identities. Omit to snapshot current admitted density at execution; [] hides every map. Named endpoints include this field explicitly. Rendering never downloads maps; unloaded or mismatched sources fail before scene mutation. Movie scene steps switch density at their midpoint.

animation.description: Native shader display effects only. These do not change molecular coordinates or scientific measurements.

plane.description: A colored molecular slice, distinct from a least-squares measurement plane. Auto uses a Cartesian frame when source principal axes are degenerate.

resolvedAtomIds.description: Stable authoritative atom IDs for dynamically resolving the displayed endpoints during the initial frame, object transforms, alignment, visibility changes, and trajectory playback.

resolvedPoints.description: Static Cartesian endpoints used when resolvedAtomIds are absent. When exact atom IDs are present, rendering derives live points from those validated atoms instead.

scientificAnnotations.description: References to quality, assembly symmetry, and exact-target guides already present in the mounted canonical scene or a saved scene. Omit to inherit current visible annotations; use empty arrays to omit them. Raw scientific records or coordinates are not accepted.

radius.description: Log2 of the occlusion radius; the native radius is 2^value.

focusSize.description: Size of the area kept in focus (Mol* PPM parameter).

radiusPercent.description: Percentage of the scene radius clipped away. Omit to preserve the camera's existing absolute clipping radius.

maxIterations.description: Log2 tracing-pass limit, further capped at 3 for live view, 4 for images, and 2 for movies.

rendersPerFrame.description: Ordered minimum/maximum rays-per-frame interval, both between 1 and 4.

tools.name: structure.render_movie
tools.title: Render Molecular Structure Movie
tools.description: Render a reproducible H.264 MP4 from the active Molecular Structure Viewer. Supply an ordered typed timeline of rotate, camera_spin, rock, zoom, focus, camera, transform, align, visibility, trajectory, trajectory_animation, spin, unwind, scene, time, and hold steps plus bounded dimensions and FPS. Timeline steps run sequentially: later focus/camera targets and alignments use transforms, visibility, and trajectory frames established earlier. camera_spin and rock use camera-space axes; spin and unwind animate representation units without rewriting molecular coordinates. unwind requires an actual loaded biological assembly. trajectory_animation supports loop, once, or palindrome with finite fixed, computed, or FPS-limited sequential timing. time advances the renderer clock for time-dependent visuals. Scene steps transition the same owned camera, representation, color, label, measurement, and annotation contract used for image rendering, including saved visual scenes. Selection annotations follow camera, object, unit, and trajectory motion. The viewer saves the MP4 and replay provenance in the active workspace. Quantization maps to a bounded streaming bitrate, not guaranteed constant-QP encoding. Do not emit raw native animation JSON or a PyMOL script. Set waitForCompletion=false only when you intend to poll structure.get_render_status.

tools.name: structure.search_motif
tools.title: Search Public Structure Motifs
tools.description: Find RCSB PDB assemblies with similar geometry for 2–10 explicitly identified public residues. Requires an explicit publicPdbId; sends only that accession and public residue/operator identities, never local coordinates or files. Author numbering is resolved against public RCSB mappings and ambiguous residues fail. structOperId means deposited RCSB operator, not a viewer-internal ASM name. Supports RMSD/tolerances, residue exchanges, and bounded pagination. Read-only; results are heuristic geometric matches, not functional assignments.

Named endpoints include this field explicitly. Rendering never downloads maps; unloaded or mismatched sources fail before scene mutation. Movie scene steps switch density at their midpoint.

animation.description: Native shader display effects only. These do not change molecular coordinates or scientific measurements.

plane.description: A colored molecular slice, distinct from a least-squares measurement plane. Auto uses a Cartesian frame when source principal axes are degenerate.

resolvedAtomIds.description: Stable authoritative atom IDs for dynamically resolving the displayed endpoints during the initial frame, object transforms, alignment, visibility changes, and trajectory playback.

resolvedPoints.description: Static Cartesian endpoints used when resolvedAtomIds are absent. When exact atom IDs are present, rendering derives live points from those validated atoms instead.

scientificAnnotations.description: References to quality, assembly symmetry, and exact-target guides already present in the mounted canonical scene or a saved scene. Omit to inherit current visible annotations; use empty arrays to omit them. Raw scientific records or coordinates are not accepted.

viewSettings.description: Bounded molecular viewport appearance. Fields merge with the current scene; camera mode, field of view, near/far distances, lighting, and background remain in their existing scene fields. Illumination remains subject to GPU capability and export-resolution limits.

radius.description: Log2 of the occlusion radius; the native radius is 2^value.

focusSize.description: Size of the area kept in focus (Mol* PPM parameter).

radiusPercent.description: Percentage of the scene radius clipped away. Omit to preserve the camera's existing absolute clipping radius.

maxIterations.description: Log2 tracing-pass limit, further capped at 3 for live view, 4 for images, and 2 for movies.

rendersPerFrame.description: Ordered minimum/maximum rays-per-frame interval, both between 1 and 4.

animation.description: Native shader display effects only. These do not change molecular coordinates or scientific measurements.

interactions.description: Computed contact settings shared by all components of each loaded object. Representation targets still control which contacts are displayed.

relativePath.description: Create-new destination relative to the trusted opened source. Parent segments are accepted only when the server proves containment in the same active workspace root.

quantization.description: Compression target: lower values request higher quality. The streaming encoder converts this to a bounded bitrate rather than promising constant-QP encoding.

clippingRadius.description: Absolute clipping radius in angstroms, retained by canonical camera snapshots.
